about: Display names for PSL glosses learned from licensed data. English and Urdu are translations of the word, never descriptions of how to sign it (CLAUDE.md 3). dictionary_url is the PSL dictionary page (psl.org.pk, FESF) that the SignSpeak authors list in links_to_words.txt as the sign they copied; SignBridge links to it and does not copy its videos.
match_rule: a dataset folder matches a gloss when both are equal after lower-casing and removing everything but a-z and 0-9
